title: DTE: Scheme overview
text: The Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana provides assistance to EBC/EWS students admitted through CAP to approved diploma, degree and postgraduate technical/professional courses. This is an excerpt/paraphrase for a local retrieval demonstration, not a copy of an entire official policy.

title: DTE: Residency and income
text: Applicant must be an Indian national and Maharashtra domicile. Family or guardian total annual income must not exceed INR 800000.

title: DTE: Admission and university
text: Student must be bonafide and admitted to an eligible professional or technical course through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP). Deemed and private universities are excluded per the scheme page.

title: DTE: Other scholarship and family
text: Applicant should not avail another scholarship or stipend. The scheme page states only two children from the family may benefit in the current academic year; exceptions or subsequent GR updates require review.

title: DTE: Attendance and gap
text: Previous-semester attendance must be at least 50 percent, except for first-semester fresh students. A course-duration education gap of two or more years is disallowed.

title: DTE: Scholarship benefits
text: The DTE page lists professional education tuition/exam fee support up to family income INR 800000, 50 percent for male and 100 percent for female students under the stated academic-year provisions. Benefit percentage is not the same as the eligibility classification.
